propositions: detached compaction sweep that dies between rename and commit leaves the tracker working tree dirty with tracked deletions and untracked snapshot/retired files, causing reconverge to abort on local changes and strand ticket commits

crash-atomic fold requires ordered mutation (snapshot-write → rename → single commit) with intent journal written before any mutation and rollback on failure, retaining uncommitted snapshots on incomplete rollback to prevent event loss

recovery must discriminate three states: journal with matching commit at HEAD (discard only), journal with uncommitted artifacts (revert and discard), and journal whose snapshot is gone from disk (discard without touching files)

transient git faults during recovery probes (index.lock, timeouts) must be treated as indeterminate rather than snapshot-absent to prevent misclassifying a transient failure as a landed fold and incorrectly reverting it
per-ticket commits inside their own locked section during sweep reduce the dirty-window exposure from an entire uncommitted batch to zero stranded folds if the sweep is killed mid-process
recovery is idempotent and runs at sweep entry within the store write lock, cleaning abandoned folds before processing new work
